next_test: Run donor/collection-held-out pseudo-bulk and compare sample-level, collection-level, and annotation-free aggregation contracts.

current_evidence: Strong: in GSE175634, day and pseudotime beat all allowed biology panels at cell level, and pseudo-bulk aggregation strengthens forbidden channels even more (pseudotime AUC 0.942; annotation AUC 0.947).
